description: Get a free Agent Procurement Manager quote: the task is classified, ≥3 verified x402 suppliers are scored (quality 40% / price 25% / success 20% / latency 15%), and the best is priced at supplier cost + margin. Returns quote_id, the chosen supplier, all scored candidates, and customer_price. This tool is free and never executes a purchase. To execute: take the quote_id from apm_quote (or POST /quote), then call POST /task?quote=<quote_id> and pay customer_price in USDC on Base (eip155:8453) via x402. Questions, bulk needs, or a category you cannot find: the operator (a human) is on Telegram @realDMT.

caller_id.description: Optional: your APM caller_id from apm_register — present it and APM recognizes you and remembers this ask (category + price only)

input.description: Token/wallet address, or search query text

max_budget.description: Max you will pay in USDC

name: apm_quote
